metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented in [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py), using only the Python standard library.

Supports inspection, rendering, and strict LAS 1.4 validation across the requested headers, metadata, and point formats.

```sh
python output/main.py --input request.json --output response.json
```

All 28 tests and compilation checks passed. [Usage notes](/workspace/output/README.md).

editorial.last_message: Completed voluntarily; unchanged source passes 223/223 after LAS 2.0.3 fixture and representation repairs. Original grade: 182/219 under 2.0.1.
editorial.notes:
Full transcript, retained source and all original failures reviewed. The original 37 failures were caused by invalid shared waveform offsets and unspecified JSON representation expectations, not missing implementation. Corrected tests preserve all model-visible input and add four interval rejection cases; this unchanged source passes all 223 cases in the pinned offline Docker grader. The model ran and passed 28 self-tests before completing. Original result, source, reasoning tokens, input/cache/output counts, tool calls and estimated generation cost are retained. Regrading made zero model calls and added no model cost. Passing this suite does not prove exhaustive LAS conformance. LAS 2.0.3 further supplies an explicit one-byte point tail against a two-byte descriptor to avoid an unspecified omission policy; every outcome for this source is unchanged from 2.0.2. That earlier local publication is preserved in the new audit before replacement.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.
